high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Medium.com, viewed on a mobile device. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 10:30, and the status bar indicates LTE connectivity with a partially charged battery. The content of the article discusses the process of training large language models (LLMs) and compares it to the development of a child's brain. The text explains that after an initial descent phase where the model adjusts its weights to improve itself, it undergoes a reinforcement learning stage.
